current_location: Quarantine bin - WMQISXM1V1-00369, pending RMA pickup

known_issues.probable_cause: Vehicle left parked for long duration with battery connected
High cycle count, heavy cargo usage, deep discharge events

incident_history.symptoms: Station rejected battery: pack voltage 37.8 V, BMS in sleep mode
incident_history.root_cause: Vehicle parked for 9 days with battery connected (fleet holiday)
incident_history.resolution: Battery recovered on service bench with low-current pre-charge (0.05C) to 42 V, then standard charge. Capacity test showed 78% SoH. Fleet partner advised to remove batteries during long parking

incident_history.symptoms: Cell group 11 temperature rose to 61°C while others at 38°C during charging in slot 9; station auto-stopped charging
incident_history.root_cause: Suspected internal short / high internal resistance in cell group 11
incident_history.resolution: Battery isolated per thermal safety SOP, moved to sand-filled quarantine bin, monitored 24 h (temperature normalised). Marked 'Do Not Use', RMA raised (RMA-2026-0388). Warranty expired - scrap/recycle evaluation pending
